extDescription.message: Your UCalgary D2L deadlines, grade weights, and a weekly workload forecast. Not affiliated with the University of Calgary or D2L.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions.

termFall.description: Term label in the popup header.

termWinter.description: Term label in the popup header.

termSpring.description: Term label in the popup header.

termSummer.description: Term label in the popup header.

welcomeTitle.message: See what's due, and what it's worth
welcomeTitle.description: Heading on the first screen, before DinoDue has read D2L.

welcomeBody.message: Open D2L and sign in. DinoDue reads your courses from there and keeps everything in this browser.
welcomeBody.description: Body text on the first screen.

openD2L.description: Button that opens d2l.ucalgary.ca in a new tab.

bannerSyncing.description: Status while DinoDue is reading D2L.

bannerWaiting.message: Open or refresh a D2L page to sync.
bannerWaiting.description: Shown when a sync was requested but no D2L page has picked it up yet.

bannerSignedOut.message: You're signed out of D2L. Sign in to refresh.
bannerSignedOut.description: Shown when D2L says the session has expired.

bannerErrorNetwork.message: Couldn't reach D2L. Showing your last sync.
bannerErrorNetwork.description: Shown when the network failed during a sync.

bannerErrorD2L.message: D2L returned an error. Showing your last sync.
bannerErrorD2L.description: Shown when D2L returned an unexpected error during a sync.

bannerErrorVersions.message: D2L didn't respond as expected. Try again later.
bannerErrorVersions.description: Shown when D2L's API version list couldn't be read.

pickerBody.message: The ones that look current are already ticked. You can change this later.
pickerBody.description: Explanation under the course picker heading.

pickerSuggested.description: Section heading for courses DinoDue thinks are current.

pickerOther.description: Section heading for the rest of the student's courses.

reasonDates.description: Why a course was suggested: its D2L dates include today.

reasonTermInName.description: Why a course was suggested: its name includes this term.

reasonRecentlyOpened.description: Why a course was suggested: the student opened it in the last two weeks.

pickerSave.description: Button that saves the course selection.

pickerNoneSelected.description: Error shown when saving with no courses ticked.

pickerEmpty.message: No courses found. Check that you're enrolled in D2L, then sync again.
pickerEmpty.description: Shown when D2L returned no usable courses.

cancel.description: Button that closes the course picker without saving.

forecastStorm.description: Forecast headline for a heavy week.

forecastCloudy.description: Forecast headline for a moderate week.

forecastClear.description: Forecast headline for a light or empty week.

forecastNoneDue.message: Nothing due in the next 7 days
forecastNoneDue.description: Forecast detail when nothing is due.

forecastStake.description: Forecast detail: combined weight of what's due this week.

sectionUpNext.description: Heading for deadlines in the next 7 days, sorted by grade weight.

sectionLater.description: Heading for deadlines 1 to 3 weeks away.

emptyUpNext.message: Nothing due soon. Enjoy the chinook.
emptyUpNext.description: Shown when there are no upcoming deadlines. A chinook is Calgary's warm winter wind.

submitted.description: Badge on an assignment the student has submitted.

weightFuzzy.message: Weight matched by name. Check it in D2L.
weightFuzzy.description: Tooltip on a weight that was matched to the gradebook by a similar name.

weightOf.description: Accessible label for the weight badge.

dueToday.description: Due time for something due today.

dueTomorrow.description: Due time for something due tomorrow.

syncNow.description: Button that refreshes data from D2L.

changeCourses.description: Link that reopens the course picker.

neverSynced.description: Shown before the first sync finishes.
